guides.title: 奈米片內側間隔層製作：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Nanosheet inner-spacer fabrication: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「內外間隔差別」建立判讀邊界。內間隔位於片間端部，外間隔位於閘外側。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate inner and outer spacers to define the interpretation boundary. Inner spacers occupy inter-sheet ends while outer spacers flank the gate. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜內外間隔差別：檢查結果是否能支持「內間隔位於片間端部，外間隔位於閘外側。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜低介電材料：檢查結果是否能支持「低介電常數不保證機械與化學耐受。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜間隔模組放行：檢查結果是否能支持「尺寸、覆蓋、低電容及釋放後存活須共同成立。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate inner and outer spacers: Check whether the evidence supports: Inner spacers occupy inter-sheet ends while outer spacers flank the gate. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Compare low-k materials: Check whether the evidence supports: Low permittivity does not guarantee mechanical or chemical robustness. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Release the spacer module: Check whether the evidence supports: Dimensions, coverage, capacitance and post-release survival must all hold. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「低介電材料」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「間隔模組放行」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Compare low-k materials: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Release the spacer module to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「內外間隔差別」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「低介電材料」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate inner and outer spacers and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for compare low-k materials and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

related.transfer: 內間隔保護源汲極，使 GAA 犧牲層能在保留通道下移除。

related.difference: 本課驗收重點是側向凹蝕、低介電填充及釋放保護；「環繞閘極奈米片電晶體」則以片間釋放、環繞閘及逐層差異為另一個工作包。共用原理不代表可照搬尺寸、材料或接受門檻。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes lateral recess, low-k fill and release protection; Gate-all-around nanosheet transistors treats inter-sheet release, wraparound gates and layer variation as a different work package.
